articles.title: Build and operate Linux software RAID safely
articles.description: Create a Linux RAID 1 array with mdadm, persist its identity, verify monitoring, and prepare a recovery path without confusing redundancy with backup.
prerequisites: A disposable Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS lab or an approved maintenance window
Two unused, equal-sized block devices with known model and serial numbers
Root or sudo access and independent console access
A verified backup stored outside the candidate member devices

articles.title: Recover a degraded mdadm RAID 1 array
articles.description: Diagnose a degraded Linux software mirror, distinguish a disk failure from path or controller faults, replace one confirmed member, and verify recovery.
prerequisites: Independent console access and an approved incident or maintenance record
A current, restore-tested backup of the affected data
A replacement disk at least as large as the failed member
The array name, filesystem mount, and stable device identifiers
